name: raven-canonical-envelope/1
description: Raven-owned demo profile: accept only canonical JSON envelopes with exact top-level keys, correct schema, and payload digest.

invocation.input: One JSON envelope object per invocation on stdin.

rules: Reject if any top-level key is outside allowed_top_level_keys (no unexpected fields).
Reject if any required_top_level_key is missing.
Reject if id is not a non-empty string.
Reject if payload is not a plain object.
Reject if digest !== sha256-hex of canonical JSON(payload) with sorted keys and no insignificant whitespace.
ACCEPT only when all rules pass.
claimed_conformance_meaning: A target claiming this profile must match corpus expected ACCEPT/REJECT decisions exactly.
